our_title: dgraphBuildGrid3D returns alone on allocation failure; other processes hang in dgraphBuild2
ran: repro/DGR-18/grid3dfi.c, pristine: `scan.sh $P18/lib bin_pristinefi/grid3dfi 2 1 0 1 -- 0 3` -> nth=0: `HANG; (1): ERROR: dgraphBuildGrid3D: out of memory (1); r1 grid3d rc=1`; nth=1: same with (2). Patched: nth=0,1 -> r0 and r1 rc=1, exit done (np=2 and np=3).
evidence: l.347-349: `errorPrint ("dgraphBuildGrid3D: out of memory (1)"); return (1);` with no collective before dgraphBuild2's MPI_Allgather on the other processes; dgraphBuildHcub (dgraph_build_hcub.c:138-157) agrees on cheklocval and on its parameters instead.

fix_options.label: A: dgraphBuildHcub-style agreement
fix_options.summary: MPI_Allreduce(MAX) of (params, -params, cheklocval) after the two allocations; free and return 1 collectively on error or inconsistent parameters.
fix_options.tested: fault injection np=2,3 (see DGR-18); check_prog_dgtst etc. unaffected (the generator is only reached through SCOTCH_dgraphBuildGrid3D)

fix_options.label: B: leave as is
fix_options.summary: Accept the hang for a test-graph generator.
fix_options.maintainer_fit: He made hcub collective, so no.

our_title: dgraphBuild3 label path: allocation failure or duplicate label on one process hangs the others (release builds)
ran: repro/DGR-12/lab.c pristine: `mpirun -np 3 lab dup 0` -> HANG (timeout); np=1 -> rc=1. repro/DGR-18 nth=3 with np=2 shows the allocation variant (masked on pristine by the DGR-18 abort). Patched: dup np=3,4 -> rc=1 on every rank; grid3dfi np=2/3 nth=3 (dgraphBuild3: out of memory) -> rc=1 on every rank.
location_7_0_17: src/libscotch/dgraph_build.c:365-401 (alloc failure returns alone l.370-371; agreement under #ifdef SCOTCH_DEBUG_DGRAPH1 l.392-396) and 460-468
evidence: l.392-396: `#ifdef SCOTCH_DEBUG_DGRAPH1 /* Communication cannot be merged with a useful one */ MPI_Allreduce (...); #else chekglbval = cheklocval; #endif` followed by `return (1)` before the MPI_Irecv/MPI_Isend ring (l.420-421) that the other processes enter.

fix_options.label: A: unconditional agreements, errors reported where found
fix_options.summary: cheklocval = 1 'assume an error', goto fail on allocation failure or local duplicate, Allreduce at fail:, free and return 1 if any process failed; second Allreduce unconditional after the ring.
fix_options.tested: repro/DGR-12 dup/unknown np=1-4; test_scotch_dgraph_build.c; relevant check targets: all CHECKPTSCOTCH targets (incl. the new check_scotch_dgraph_build) pass on the 32-bit ASan tree and the 64-bit tree (chk_32_summary.txt, chk_64_summary.txt; np=3 via the Makefile, plus the dgraph test programs, dgtst and dgpart with -np 1, 2 and 4); the dgraph targets pass on the -DSCOTCH_DEBUG_ALL tree (chk_dbg_summary.txt). The only sanitizer hits are pre-existing ones in other groups' files (library_dgraph_coarsen.c:163 memcpy with NULL, bgraph_bipart_ml.c:195 null offset), identical to G18's logs.
fix_options.tradeoffs: Two int Allreduces per labeled build in release mode (negligible next to the P-round ring exchange of 2*vertglbmax Gnums). Reverses the maintainer's explicit 'cannot be merged' choice: USER DECISION, same as G18's.

fix_options.label: B: piggyback the error on the ring messages
fix_options.summary: Send an odd-length message as an error marker in the first ring round and let every process forward it.
fix_options.tradeoffs: No extra collective but intricate; the allocation failure happens before the buffers exist, so the failing process would need a separate small buffer.
fix_options.maintainer_fit: Too clever; he did not do it in 2026 reworks.

our_title: dgraphGhst2 leaks the send index array on the healthy processes when another process fails
why_not_run: leak only; ASan leak detection is disabled under MPI (MPI itself leaks) so it cannot be observed cleanly; the patch for DGR-08 removes it by construction (procsidtab attached only after the agreement).
evidence: l.284: `grafptr->procsidtab = memRealloc (procsidtab, ...)`, l.294-295: `if (reduglbtab[0] != 0) return (1);` with DGRAPHFREEPSID set only at l.298; dgraphFree2 frees procsidtab only under DGRAPHFREEPSID; a later successful dgraphGhst overwrites the pointer.

fix_options.label: A: attach after agreement, free on error

our_title: dgraphLoadCent/Dist set DGRAPHFREETABS after dgraphBuild2 whatever its result: arrays leak on early failure (G20's file)
why_not_run: G20 owns dgraph_io_load.c; not patched here.
evidence: `o = dgraphBuild2 (grafptr, baseval, ...); grafptr->flagval |= DGRAPHFREETABS | DGRAPHVERTGROUP | DGRAPHEDGEGROUP; return (o);` : when dgraphBuild2 fails before dgraphBuild3 attaches the arrays (private data allocation, DGR-05 path), vertloctax/edgeloctax allocated by the loader are never freed; when it fails inside dgraphBuild3 after attaching them, the flags make dgraphExit free them (correct, and the reason the double free of DGR-18 does not occur here).

fix_options.label: A: free the arrays when dgraphBuild2 fails and the graph did not take them
fix_options.summary: `if (o != 0) { if (grafptr->vertloctax == NULL) { memFree (edgeloctax + baseval); memFree (vertloctax + baseval); } }` before setting the flags, or the grid3d/hcub pattern (free on failure, flags on success).

our_title: dgraphBuildHcub leaks both arrays on the 'inconsistent parameters' path (file shared with G02)
why_not_run: parameter inconsistency across processes is a caller bug; file touched by G02's patch 0003, left to avoid a collision.
evidence: `if ((reduglbtab[1] != - reduglbtab[0]) || ...) { errorPrint ("dgraphBuildHcub: inconsistent parameters"); return (1); }` after both memAllocGroups succeeded, without memFree (vertloctax)/(edgeloctax).

fix_options.label: A: free before returning
fix_options.summary: Add `memFree (edgeloctax); memFree (vertloctax);` (un-based at that point) before the return, or merge the test into the reduglbtab[6] block as patch 0003 does for grid3d.

our_title: dgraphBuildGrid3D parameter checks are debug-only: zero increment or dimension divides by zero through the public API
ran: repro/PS2-G17-1/gridparm.c on the pristine ASan build, np=2: `gridparm 4 4 2 0` -> `dgraph_build_grid3d.c:387:13: runtime error: division by zero` then SIGFPE on both ranks; `gridparm 0 4 2 1` -> division by zero at l.438; `gridparm 4 4 2 -1` -> rc=0 and a graph that fails SCOTCH_dgraphCheck ('arc data do not match'). Patched (np=1,2,3): every invalid parameter set -> 'dgraphBuildGrid3D: invalid parameters', rc=1 on every rank; valid sets build and check.
evidence: l.306-315: `#ifdef SCOTCH_DEBUG_DGRAPH1 if ((dimxval < 1) || (dimyval < 1) || (dimzval < 1)) {...} if (incrval < 1) {...} #endif`; l.387: `t = a % b;` with b = (vertglbnbr + incrval) - max (vertglbnbr, incrval) = 0 when incrval = 0; l.438: `poszval = vertglbmin / (dimxval * dimyval);`

fix_options.label: A: unconditional checks folded into the process agreement
fix_options.summary: Test the four parameters before allocating, set cheklocval on failure, and let the Allreduce of patch 0003 make every process return 1.
fix_options.tested: repro/PS2-G17-1 np=1,2,3; repro/DGR-18 fault-injection scans rerun (unchanged results); 32-bit and 64-bit trees rebuild with 0 warnings; check_scotch_dgraph_check/build/induce rerun on the 64-bit tree (chk_64b_summary.txt).
fix_options.tradeoffs: Four comparisons per call; the two debug messages '(1)'/'(2)' become one.
fix_options.maintainer_fit: His 2026 'Add parameter check to SCOTCH_dgraphRedist()' (b10825d) adds unconditional API checks; folding them into the existing agreement keeps the routine collective.

fix_options.label: B: G17's diff (drop the #ifdef only)
fix_options.summary: Make the two checks unconditional with their early non-collective returns.
fix_options.tradeoffs: Correct when all processes pass the same parameters (then all return early); if they disagree, the processes with valid parameters enter the agreement of patch 0003 and wait forever.
fix_options.maintainer_fit: Would be fine on pristine 7.0.17 (no agreement there), not on top of patch 0003.
